get_config_from_yaml: create a unified Habitat config by merging default values with YAML config files and command line opts
get_config_with_opts: create a Habitat config with custom options passed as a flat key-value list for parameter sweeping
configure_rl_policy: configure the RL policy name, action distribution type, and observation transforms for navigation training
configure_ppo_hyperparams: configure PPO hyperparameters including learning rate, clip param, gamma, and entropy coefficient
configure_ddpppo_distributed: configure distributed DD-PPO settings including backbone, RNN type, sync fraction, and pretrained weights
